12.0.en: The way down brought them to a little [[wooden:wooden]] shack by the trail.
12.0.zh: 下山的路把他们带到路边一间小木棚。

12.1.en: At the little station they studied basic [[meteorology:meteorology]] on a surprisingly [[mild:mild]] afternoon.
12.1.zh: 在小站里，他们在一个意外温和的午后学起基础气象学。

12.2.en: The old electric [[heating:heating]] kept the room warm while they ate a [[moderate:moderate]] dinner.
12.2.zh: 旧电暖气让房间暖暖的，他们吃着适量的一顿晚餐。

12.3.en: Each of them wore a thick [[thermal:thermal]] coat against the [[night:night]] cold.
12.3.zh: 人人都穿上厚实的保暖外套抵御夜寒。

12.4.en: They compared this cold with the wet heat of the distant [[tropics:tropics]].
12.4.zh: 他们把这里的冷，和远方热带的湿热作了比较。

12.5.en: One researcher had once worked in an [[arid:arid]] [[desert:desert]] where nothing grows.
12.5.zh: 一位研究员曾在寸草不生的干旱沙漠里工作过。

12.6.en: Outdoors, the evening soil stayed soft and [[moist:moist]] after the light rain.
12.6.zh: 屋外小雨过后，傍晚的土壤依然松软潮湿。

13.0.en: Late at [[night:night]] their coats still felt cold and [[damp:damp]] from the rain.
13.0.zh: 深夜里，外套被雨打湿，摸上去又冷又潮。

13.1.en: The small room turned uncomfortably [[humid:humid]] as the wet clothing dried by the heater.
13.1.zh: 湿衣服在暖气边烘烤，小房间闷热得让人难受。

13.2.en: By morning they spotted white [[snowy:snowy]] peaks glowing in the pale sunshine.
13.2.zh: 清晨，他们望见白雪覆盖的山峰在淡淡的阳光下发亮。

13.3.en: Thin [[frost:frost]] covered the windows and their stiff boots.
13.3.zh: 薄霜盖住了窗户和冻硬的靴子。

13.4.en: Suddenly loud [[hail:hail]] pounded on the roof and woke the whole station.
13.4.zh: 突然，大冰雹猛砸屋顶，惊醒了全站的人。

13.5.en: By noon the fallen ice began to [[thaw:thaw]] under the weak sun.
13.5.zh: 到中午，落下的冰雹在微弱的阳光下开始融化。

14.0.en: Far to the north, another story was unfolding in the cold [[polar:polar]] [[night:night]].
14.0.zh: 在遥远的北方，另一个故事正在寒冷的极夜里展开。

14.1.en: The evening [[chill:chill]] bit deep, and the puddles on the pier began to [[freeze:freeze]].
14.1.zh: 傍晚的寒气刺骨，码头上的水洼开始结冰。

14.2.en: Old Lars faced [[frigid:frigid]] winds on the frozen northern pier.
14.2.zh: 老拉尔斯在结冰的北码头迎着严寒的风。

14.3.en: His hands began to [[tremble:tremble]] as icy spray soaked his gloves.
14.3.zh: 冰冷的水花浸湿手套，他的双手开始颤抖。

14.4.en: Soon he was [[shiver:shivering]] despite his thick fleece coat.
14.4.zh: 尽管穿着厚厚的抓绒大衣，他很快还是浑身发抖。

14.5.en: He tied the boat fast and hurried toward the warm [[harbour:harbour]] lights.
14.5.zh: 他系牢小船，快步走向温暖的港灯。

14.6.en: Then distant [[thunder:thunder]] rolled across the dark, heavy clouds.
14.6.zh: 接着，远处的雷声滚过厚重的乌云。

15.0.en: Suddenly bright [[lightning:lightning]] tore the sky above his small boat.
15.0.zh: 突然，明亮的闪电撕裂了小船上方的天空。

15.1.en: The [[stormy:stormy]] waves tossed the boat against the [[harbour:harbour]] wall.
15.1.zh: 狂暴的海浪把船抛向港口的堤墙。

15.2.en: A sudden [[downpour:downpour]] drenched him while he pulled the last rope.
15.2.zh: 他拉最后一根绳索时，一阵倾盆大雨把他浇了个透。

15.3.en: He later learned that the evening's [[rainfall:rainfall]] had broken the village record.
15.3.zh: 后来他才知道，那晚的降雨量破了村里的纪录。

15.4.en: Back home, he marked the date in red on the wall, hoping the [[seasonal:seasonal]] rains would return.
15.4.zh: 回家后，他在墙上用红笔圈下这个日子，盼着季节性的雨季再来。

16.0.en: Early in the morning, Mina [[sprinkle:sprinkles]] sugar into her tea and takes a quick [[shower:shower]] before the climb.
16.0.zh: 清晨，米娜往茶里撒了点糖，冲了个快澡，便准备出发登山。

16.1.en: Outdoors it is already twenty-five degrees [[celsius:Celsius]], and such a high [[temperature:temperature]] softens the deep snow.
16.1.zh: 户外已经二十五摄氏度，这么高的温度把深深的积雪都泡软了。

16.2.en: Yet the radio [[forecast:forecast]] promises cool winds near the [[snowy:snowy]] [[peak:peak]].
16.2.zh: 不过收音机里的天气预报说，雪峰附近会有凉风。

16.3.en: By noon she stands on the [[hillside:hillside]] path, laughing at her own haste.
16.3.zh: 到中午，她已站在山坡小路上，笑自己太过心急。

16.4.en: There she helps her friend [[mount:mount]] a small detector on the boulder.
16.4.zh: 她在那儿帮朋友把一台小探测器装到巨石上。

16.5.en: Together they watch the distant [[mountain:mountain]] crest glow in the evening light.
16.5.zh: 傍晚，他们一起望着暮色里发亮的远处山脊。

17.0.en: Young Ken knows all the nearby [[range:ranges]] well and leads guests along the [[narrow:narrow]] [[ridge:ridge]].
17.0.zh: 小肯对附近的每条山脉都了如指掌，带客人走在狭窄的山脊上。

17.1.en: They come down the grassy [[slope:slope]] into a peaceful green [[valley:valley]] dotted with sheep.
17.1.zh: 他们顺着草坡而下，走进点缀着绵羊的宁静绿色山谷。

17.2.en: Children race down the sunny [[hillside:hillside]], past the spot where Ken [[overlook:overlooks]] the whole village.
17.2.zh: 孩子们在洒满阳光的山坡上奔跑，经过肯俯瞰全村的地方。

17.3.en: In her room his grandmother hung an [[oriental:oriental]] tapestry, saying that losing this land would be [[inevitable:inevitable]] if no one guarded it.
17.3.zh: 祖母在屋里挂起一幅东方风格的挂毯，她说如果没人守护，失去这片土地将不可避免。

17.4.en: Ana studies [[irreversible:irreversible]] harm in the wetlands, taking water samples [[irregularly:irregularly]].
17.4.zh: 安娜研究湿地遭受的不可逆伤害，断断续续地采集水样。

17.5.en: Last April, when she found [[abnormal:abnormal]] algae by the old conduit, Ana said that dumping waste there would be highly [[inappropriate:inappropriate]].
17.5.zh: 去年四月，她在旧管道旁发现异常的水藻，便说往那儿倒废料是极不合适的。

18.0.en: The slow river carries thick [[sediment:sediment]] while soft [[silt:silt]] settles among the roots.
18.0.zh: 缓缓的河水带着厚厚的沉积物，松软的淤泥在根系间慢慢沉下。

18.1.en: After storms the bank turns soft and [[muddy:muddy]], so she moulds the [[damp:damp]] [[clay:clay]] into small bricks to show her class.
18.1.zh: 暴雨过后河岸松软泥泞，她就用湿黏土捏成小砖块，带给同学们看。

18.2.en: At daybreak Sam wipes [[dirt:dirt]] from his windscreen before his long [[rural:rural]] delivery run.
18.2.zh: 破晓时分，小萨姆擦净挡风玻璃上的尘土，开始漫长的乡村送货行程。

18.3.en: His [[first:first]] stop is a [[quiet:quiet]] farm, his second a leafy [[suburb:suburb]] full of waiting children.
18.3.zh: 第一站是安静的农场，第二站是绿树成荫的郊区，那里有一群等着收包裹的孩子。

18.4.en: Then come the factories on the dusty [[outskirts:outskirts]] of town.
18.4.zh: 接着是镇郊尘土飞扬的工厂区。

18.5.en: After lunch he drives on toward a [[remote:remote]] farm down a long [[desolate:desolate]] road.
18.5.zh: 午饭后，他继续沿一条荒凉漫长的路，开往远处偏僻的农庄。

19.0.en: Two warehouses stand [[adjacent:adjacent]] to the old station, but Sam refuses any [[toxic:toxic]] shipment without sealed boxes.
19.0.zh: 两座仓库紧挨着老车站，但没有密封箱，萨姆拒运任何有毒货物。

19.1.en: Maya investigates river [[pollution:pollution]] and finds one oily [[pollutant:pollutant]] leaking from a rusty conduit.
19.1.zh: 玛雅调查河流污染，发现一种油性污染物正从生锈的管道里渗出。

19.2.en: That waste could [[contaminate:contaminate]] the wells, so her class joins the weekend [[geology:geology]] outings to watch the water.
19.2.zh: 这些废料可能污染水井，于是全班报名参加周末的地质考察，顺便盯着水质。

19.3.en: They take samples along the grassy [[fringe:fringe]] of the pines, where Maya drops her enamel [[plate:plate]] on the rocks.
19.3.zh: 他们在松林边缘的草地上取样，玛雅却把搪瓷盘摔在了石头上。

19.4.en: The flood has scattered sharp [[debris:debris]] across the path, and she spots a thin [[crack:crack]] spreading in the old bridge wall.
19.4.zh: 洪水把尖锐的碎片撒满小路，她还发现旧桥墙上有一道细缝正在变长。

19.5.en: She photographs both and sends them to the county hall, hoping to [[trace:trace]] the [[leak:leak]] that same day.
19.5.zh: 她把两处都拍下照片，当天送到县政厅，希望就此追查到泄漏的源头。

20.0.en: Leo photographed the [[splendid:splendid]] [[sunrise:sunrise]] above the [[quiet:quiet]] lake.
20.0.zh: 利奥拍下了宁静湖面上壮丽的日出。

20.1.en: Later he visited a [[grand:grand]] palace built by ancient kings.
20.1.zh: 后来他参观了古代国王建造的宏伟宫殿。

20.2.en: The vast canyon looked truly [[magnificent:magnificent]] as the guide told a very [[interesting:interesting]] legend.
20.2.zh: 向导讲着一个很有趣的传说，眼前的深邃峡谷显得格外壮丽。

20.3.en: Then a [[dramatic:dramatic]] change in the wind turned the sky from blue to black over the silent [[wilderness:wilderness]].
20.3.zh: 接着风向骤变，寂静荒野上空的天色由蓝转黑。

20.4.en: At [[dawn:dawn]] they crossed a hot dry [[desert:desert]] of low prickly bushes.
20.4.zh: 拂晓时分，他们穿过一片炎热干旱的沙漠，地上只长着低矮的带刺灌木。

20.5.en: Seeing the fallen trees, Leo vowed never to [[deforest:deforest]] the land for profit.
20.5.zh: 看到倒下的树，利奥发誓绝不为赚钱砍伐这片土地上的森林。

21.0.en: Our village once struggled beside a vast [[barren:barren]] [[plain:plain]] without crops.
21.0.zh: 我们村曾在一片种不出庄稼的贫瘠大平原旁苦苦挣扎。

21.1.en: Then we found deep [[fertile:fertile]] soil along the riverbank.
21.1.zh: 后来，我们在河岸边发现了深厚的肥沃土壤。

21.2.en: Every [[spring:spring]] we [[fertilise:fertilise]] the fields before sowing the golden barley.
21.2.zh: 每年春天，我们都先给田地施肥，再种下金色的大麦。

21.3.en: Tall [[solar:solar]] panels now drive the pumps that lift river water.
21.3.zh: 高大的太阳能板如今驱动水泵，把河水提上来。

21.4.en: At [[night:night]] Grandpa studies the pale [[lunar:lunar]] light while planning the harvest.
21.4.zh: 夜里，爷爷借着淡淡的月光盘算着收成。

21.5.en: We rise early to watch the golden [[sunrise:sunrise]] spread over the barley.
21.5.zh: 我们清早起身，看金色的日出漫过大麦田。

22.0.en: After hard work we gather to enjoy the peaceful [[sunset:sunset]].
22.0.zh: 忙完农活，大家聚在一起欣赏宁静的日落。

22.1.en: Last autumn we even watched a strange partial [[eclipse:eclipse]] together.
22.1.zh: 去年秋天，我们还一起看到了一次奇特的日偏食。

22.2.en: At [[dusk:dusk]] the village walks home under a glowing sky that looks like [[heaven:heaven]].
22.2.zh: 黄昏时分，全村人走在回家的路上，头顶发亮的天空美得像天堂。

22.3.en: Someone whispers that our [[valley:valley]] feels exactly like a green [[paradise:paradise]].
22.3.zh: 有人轻声说，我们的山谷简直就像一座绿色乐园。

22.4.en: Thin white [[vapour:vapour]] rises softly from the warm soup pots.
22.4.zh: 缕缕洁白的水汽从热腾腾的汤锅里轻轻升起。

22.5.en: Daytime heat makes [[shallow:shallow]] pools quickly [[evaporate:evaporate]] in the bright sun.
22.5.zh: 白天的暑气让浅浅的水洼在烈日下很快蒸发。

23.0.en: Cool breezes [[circulate:circulate]] through the lanes after the hot afternoon.
23.0.zh: 炎热的午后过去，凉风在小巷里来回流动。

23.1.en: A small quarrel over water almost [[precipitate:precipitated]] a serious clash last summer.
23.1.zh: 去年夏天，一场为争水的小争吵差点引发严重的冲突。

23.2.en: Luckily the old stone [[reservoir:reservoir]] holds enough water for everyone.
23.2.zh: 幸好村外那座老石水库蓄的水，够所有人用。

23.3.en: Next morning the children trek together toward the noisy distant [[waterfall:waterfall]].
23.3.zh: 次日清晨，孩子们结伴徒步，朝远处轰鸣的瀑布走去。

23.4.en: They laugh around the old stone [[fountain:fountain]] in the sunny square.
23.4.zh: 他们围着广场上阳光下古老的石喷泉欢笑。

23.5.en: Fresh morning [[dew:dew]] still covers the soft turf along the path.
23.5.zh: 清晨新鲜的露珠，还挂在路边柔软的草地上。

paraZh.14: 极夜里的渔夫老拉尔斯：严寒颤抖系船，雷声滚来，暴雨破纪录。
